canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at Nuance: the honest answer is 'don't'

parent.title: Weekend at Nuance: a 2-Michelin dinner with no hotel next door

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Nuance
siblings.summary: Around the 2-Michelin Nuance dinner in Duffel: Mechelen is 5 min by train, Antwerp 15 min, Lier 9 min by bus — plus the Sunday-museum / Monday-shop rhythm, breweries, forts and cycle routes you should know.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Nuance
siblings.summary: Heritage and design hotels — convents, orphanages, city palaces — all within a 10-25 minute taxi of Thierry Theys' two-star Nuance in Duffel.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Nuance
siblings.summary: 2026 calendar of IT conferences and tech meetups inside a 30 km radius of Michelin-starred Nuance in Duffel — bundling options for the Saturday-dinner trip.

sources.title: Nuance — official site
sources.claim: Nuance restaurant official address is Kiliaanstraat 6-8, 2570 Duffel.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Nuance, Duffel
sources.claim: Nuance carries 2 Michelin stars and chef is Thierry Theys.

sources.title: Nuance — recommended hotels & transport
sources.claim: Nuance's own 'recommended hotels' list contains zero properties in Duffel itself; all four picks are in Mechelen or Antwerp, each reached by an 18-24 minute drive.

sources.title: Taxi Symforosa — tariff
sources.claim: Taxi Symforosa is Nuance's transport partner; pricing is a one-time €3.50 departure fee plus a per-km rate, with a €3 night surcharge between 22:00 and 06:00.

sources.title: a-hotel.com — Duffel accommodation directory
sources.claim: Duffel has 3 total accommodation options: 0 hotels, 0 apartments, 2 pensions, and 1 other offering.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — hotels near Nuance
sources.claim: Tripadvisor's 'closest hotels to Nuance' list starts at 3.4 km; no hotel of any kind is listed within 3 km.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — 't Schaeruyt
sources.claim: 't Schaeruyt is the only guest house Tripadvisor lists inside Duffel proper.

sources.title: Booking.com — Station 25A
sources.claim: Station 25A is a one-bedroom holiday cottage at Notmeir 70, 2570 Duffel.

sources.title: bedandbreakfast.eu — Duffel listings
sources.claim: Of 99 B&Bs returned for 'Duffel' only three are actually inside Duffel.

sources.title: Duffel municipality — logeren in Duffel
sources.claim: The official municipality 'logeren in Duffel' page lists only Vakantiestudio Kleine Johannes as an overnight option in the town.

sources.title: guesthouses.be — Duffel region
sources.claim: Kleine Johannes lists at €55/night and accommodates 2 in a rural setting.

sources.title: Nilvaevents — bedandbreakfast.eu
sources.claim: Nilvaevents is a 6-person group B&B with pool table, playground, and dietary breakfasts.
